description: FoldIndex disorder, RNA-binding motif scan, prion-like Q/N profile for RDE-2
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, re, json
seq = open("rde2_Q19672.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
pl = np.load("plddt.npy"); L=len(seq)

# --- FoldIndex (Prilusky et al. 2005, Bioinformatics 21:3435): 2.785<H> - |<R>| - 1.151
KD = dict(zip("AVLIPFMWGSTCYNQDEKRH",[1.8,4.2,3.8,4.5,-1.6,2.8,1.9,-0.9,-0.4,-0.8,-0.7,2.5,-1.3,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.5,-3.9,-4.5,-3.2]))
Hn = {a:(v+4.5)/9.0 for a,v in KD.items()}   # normalised 0-1
def foldindex(s, w=51):
    out=np.full(len(s), np.nan)
    for i in range(len(s)):
        a=max(0,i-w//2); b=min(len(s),i+w//2+1); sub=s[a:b]
        H=np.mean([Hn[c] for c in sub])
        R=(sum(sub.count(c) for c in "KR")-sum(sub.count(c) for c in "DE"))/len(sub)
        out[i]=2.785*H-abs(R)-1.151
    return out
fi = foldindex(seq)
def segs(mask,minlen=15):
    out=[];s=None
    for i,v in enumerate(mask):
        if v and s is None: s=i
        if not v and s is not None:
            if i-s>=minlen: out.append((s+1,i)); 
            s=None
    if s is not None and len(mask)-s>=minlen: out.append((s+1,len(mask)))
    return out
print("FoldIndex<0 (predicted disordered) segments >=15aa:")
for a,b in segs(fi<0,15): print(f"   {a:3d}-{b:3d} ({b-a+1:3d} aa)")
print("\nConsensus disorder (FoldIndex<0 AND pLDDT<70), >=15aa:")
cons = segs((fi<0)&(pl<70),15)
for a,b in cons: print(f"   {a:3d}-{b:3d} ({b-a+1:3d} aa)")
print("\nConsensus order (FoldIndex>0 AND pLDDT>=70):")
for a,b in segs((fi>0)&(pl>=70),10): print(f"   {a:3d}-{b:3d} ({b-a+1:3d} aa)")

# --- RNA-binding sequence signatures
print("\n=== RNA-binding signature scan ===")
for name,pat in [("RGG (RGG/RGG-box)", r"RGG"), ("RG repeat RG.{0,2}RG", r"RG.{0,2}RG"),
                 ("GRG/GGR", r"GG[RK]|[RK]GG"), ("YGG", r"[YF]GG"),
                 ("K/R-rich 6-mer (>=4 K/R)", None), ("RS dipeptide", r"RS"), ("RRR/KKK tract", r"[KR]{3,}")]:
    if pat:
        m=[(x.start()+1,x.group()) for x in re.finditer(pat, seq)]
        print(f"  {name:28s} n={len(m)}  {m[:12]}")
# K/R patch scan: windows of 10 with >=5 K/R
kr=[1 if c in "KR" else 0 for c in seq]
patches=[(i+1, seq[i:i+10], sum(kr[i:i+10])) for i in range(L-9) if sum(kr[i:i+10])>=5]
print("  K/R patches (>=5 of 10):", patches)
print("  arginine count:", seq.count("R"), " lysine:", seq.count("K"))

# --- prion-like: Q/N fraction in 80-aa windows (Michelitsch & Weissman style) & PAPA-like
qn80=np.array([ (sum(seq[max(0,i-40):i+40].count(c) for c in "QN")/len(seq[max(0,i-40):i+40])) for i in range(L)])
print("\nMax Q/N fraction in 80-aa window: %.3f at residue %d" % (qn80.max(), int(qn80.argmax())+1))
print("Q/N fraction 1-80: %.3f ; 239-339: %.3f" % (
    sum(seq[:80].count(c) for c in "QN")/80, sum(seq[238:339].count(c) for c in "QN")/101))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,8),sharex=True)
x=np.arange(1,L+1)
ax[0].plot(x,pl,c="#2b6cb0"); ax[0].axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey"); ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax[0].set_title("RDE-2/MUT-8 disorder: AlphaFold pLDDT, FoldIndex, Q/N content")
ax[1].plot(x,fi,c="#805ad5"); ax[1].axhline(0,c="k",lw=.7); ax[1].set_ylabel("FoldIndex\n(<0 disordered)")
ax[2].plot(x,qn80,c="#276749"); ax[2].axhline(0.30,ls=":",c="red"); ax[2].set_ylabel("Q+N fraction\n(80-aa window)"); ax[2].set_xlabel("residue")
for a in ax:
    a.axvspan(1,45,color="#f6e05e",alpha=.3); a.axvspan(236,345,color="#90cdf4",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
